text: {"name":"ble_scan_apply_config","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Applies BLE scan enable and configuration settings to controller registers, then updates header word 102.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"a2":"scan_config","v4":"scan_enable_request","v10":"scan_control_value"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Scan-enable request, honored only when the global scan permission is set"},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Controls bit 31 of a scan-control register"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Enables updating the scan parameter registers"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Value copied to a scan parameter register"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Value shifted into the upper bits of a scan parameter register"}]}
